articles.headline: Planet Green Enters the Fast Growing Global Lactoferrin Market, Adding Chief Scientist to Drive Innovation-Based Product Portfolio Growth
sourceWarnings: El titular habla de incorporar un científico jefe, pero el cuerpo indica negociaciones con un candidato; no se registra como nombramiento ya cerrado.
articles.summary: Planet Green announced commercial sourcing and distribution of lactoferrin and negotiations to recruit a chief scientist. Despite the headline, the candidate had not yet been appointed.
